description.narrative: As a result of unprecedented rainfall since mid-March 2019 Iran has experienced widespread flooding beginning with flash floods and landslides in Golestan Province subsequently spreading further north and east causing extensive damage to people livelihoods agriculture and infrastructure. At least 23 out of 31 provinces across Iran are affected. While the exact impact is still to be assessed it is already apparent that the floods have caused extensive damages and suffering in villages urban and rural areas. To date 1 905 cities villages and mountain roads have been affected. The estimated financial impact of damages to agriculture and infrastructure reaches millions of dollars. IRCS has reported 70 persons dead and at least 790 persons injured. IRCS has been responding across the country since the onset. A DREF was requested and subsquently an IFRC Emergency Appeal launched on 07/04/2019 for 5.1M CHF: to support 150 000 people for 9 months with a focus on the following areas: Shelter; Livelihoods and basic Needs; Protection Gender and Inclusion (PGI). BRC have held an ETF and SAT (09.04.2019) and intend to soft pledge a 100k unearmarked contribution to the IFRC EA.
